course_name_original: İngilizce Akademik Yazma ve Sunum Becerileri
course_name_en: English Academic Writing and Presentation Skills

learning_outcomes.text: Students acquire correct language use, logical structure, and effective organization skills in academic writing.
Students gain proficiency in effectively integrating and citing sources.
Students develop English oral communication skills and express their topics clearly and effectively.
Students successfully communicate and write in academic environments.
Students effectively write English scientific articles, reports, and other academic text types.

syllabus_topics: Basic academic writing rules and techniques
Key elements of an effective presentation
Feedback from other students and faculty members
bibliography: Hartley, J. (2008). Academic writing and publishing: A practical handbook. Routledge.
Tuomainen, S. (2016). A blended learning approach to academic writing and presentation skills. International Journal on Language, Literature and Culture in Education, 3(2), 33-55.
Koleva, A., Branekova, D., & Zafirov, H. (2018). Presentation and communication skills in the academic preparation of students of pedagogy. Trakia Journal of Science, 16(2), 77-82
academic_year: vigente en el Bologna Bilgi Sistemi (Yeni)
